children.text: FX mode = a DIM SCRIM over the UNMODIFIED track view + floating per-pedal ON/OFF toggles. Owner pivot 2026-08-27: this SUPERSEDES the in-place transform in VOgon (STAGE / stage-fx), which was rejected for re-dressing the track columns into chain tiles. New model: FX mode must NOT modify the track view behind it — the 4 track columns render EXACTLY as in normal mode (this frame is a verbatim copy of Ob2Mu = STAGE / stage; nothing in the track run was touched). On entering FX mode a translucent dark scrim ($bg-scrim, here bumped to ~55% black #0505088c) lays over the whole stage so the untouched tracks stay recognizable but recede. On top of the scrim float 4 FX controls, one centered over each track column — pedal N sits above column N, preserving footswitch spatial continuity. Each floating control shows the BOUND CHAIN's identity chain-first with its REAL target (MASTER · REVERB, LANE 2 · DRIVE, INPUT · GATE) and an ON/OFF switch — these are ON/OFF ONLY, NOT selectable like tracks: no selection border, no track-style tile, so the performer never learns a false tile=track-FX model. Purple FX accent for ON ($fx #a06be0 on $fx-surface #1e1430), dim/neutral for OFF. A pedal with no bound chain shows a subtle 'unbound' empty state (not a big NO CHAIN tile). DS reuse: FxPowerToggle (mHM0y) power glyph, $fx / $fx-surface / $bg-scrim tokens, radius-12, font-mono labels, the MASTER · REVERB chain-first label idiom from VOgon. Judgment calls for owner to confirm: scrim opacity (~55% here, tunable 40–55%), card width 300 / vertical placement centered in the track area, switch vs pill for the ON/OFF affordance, and the 'unbound' treatment (solid dim card here). This is a design example for approval — no app code touched.
